lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: There's a huge boulder over there.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Massive waves are constantly crashing against it.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: So, if you stand on top of it, it feels like you're a waterpower god.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why don't you just shorten it to water god?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Make way for Anis, water god number two!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I guess you could do that...

lines.speaker: frima
lines.text: Zzzz...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Frima has somehow managed to fall asleep while walking.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Wow... this is kinda freaky.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Maybe she's only pretending to be asleep.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Perhaps we should do a sleep test, then?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: *Sigh*
Helm, you seem out of sorts.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Huh... I do?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Is it that obvious?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I feel like I'm bringing the mood down, sorry.
Is it because of Mast and Anchor?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I wanted all three of us to be here.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: All aboard the Admire as well, of course.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Don't let it get you down. Instead, have as much fun as possible on their behalf.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: In case you've forgotten, this is a mission, not purely recreation.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Sure, but Andersen said that if everything's on the up and up,

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: after our initial recon, we can kick back and relax.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Isn't that right, Commander?
Right.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway, it's nice to have you along for the ride, Helm.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You know everything there is to know about the sea, so we can ask you all kinds of stuff.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How could I not be stoked?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Hey, that's a good point!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Do you know a lot about waterpower?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I've had an interest in waterpower ever since coming back from our last trip.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: If I could use both firepower and waterpower... wouldn't that be something?!

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I don't think I'll be of much assistance in that regard.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Sorry.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh, okay...

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: If not you, then who could possibly be the master of waterpower...?

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: 500 meters until the destination.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I'll install a decoy near the island.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Neon, can you help?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: You got it!
Rapi and Neon split off in two different directions.
After we pass through a patch of trees,
a wide sand bar can be seen, with the endless blue sea spreading out in front of it.
I can hear Helm inhale sharply.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It doesn't matter how often I gaze upon the sea.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Its beauty just never ceases to amaze me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Woohoo, we're finally here!

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Is that island over there our destination?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Correct.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Our previous observations show that the path tends to open up in week-long chunks.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Just a week?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Are you saying that this pathway leading to the island closes off later?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Yep, that's why the Commander and the rest of them got stuck on the island before.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Bad luck on them.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Anyway, it hasn't been long since the road opened so we should be okay for 6-7 days.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The only reason they got marooned on the island before was because they didn't know any of this then.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Mast would have loved seeing this.
We sit back and take in the ocean views for a while, after which Neon and Rapi come back.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Decoy has been deployed.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: For the time being, this island is as safe as can be.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: So there's no danger whatsoever?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Nope!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: We installed a decoy on the only pathway leading in, and the other sides are all surrounded by water, so we're good to go.
Nicely done.
Let's go over to the island now.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: It's been a while,

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: but the villa Liter built is virtually unchanged.

lines.speaker: liter
lines.text: As if it would be any other way! I built this thing to last.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Our clinic is still the same as well.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Still as charming as ever!

lines.speaker: frima_s
lines.text: Me. Sleep.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What the... when did you change into your swimsuit?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I see you've entered vacation mode already.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Help Neon unpack the supplies.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: The Commander and I are going to check out the signal.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: On it.

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: Should we clean up the clinic a bit, Pepper?

lines.speaker: mary
lines.text: We should change as well.

lines.speaker: pepper
lines.text: Yes, ma'am!

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Helm, you know more about the sea than any of us.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Could you come along and help us out?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Thanks.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Let's head out, Commander.
With Rapi and Helm, I walk to the coordinates set out by Andersen.
We're nearby.
*Splash*

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I don't see anything.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I don't hear anything out of the ordinary either.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: This is pointing out the obvious, but I don't sense any Raptures.
Helm, do you feel anything?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: ... I don't feel anything.
So, it's as we figured.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I should change into my swimsuit.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: We might discover something in the water.
We'll check it out together.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Let's head back to the villa for now.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Huh? You're back quick.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Did you find something?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Not a thing.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: We're going underwater to check, just in case.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Where are my belongings?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Over there.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're going to wear your swimsuit?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Someone once donated a swimsuit at one of our fundraisers.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I brought it just in case I would have to swim.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hm.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I better change too, then.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Why are you changing?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why wouldn't I? To get into the summertime spirit, of course.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What else would you wear when you're on the beach?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I wanted to wear this thing in June but never got the chance.
*Bang*

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Tah-dah!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: I've officially switched to my water outfit.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Isn't it cute? Hehe!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you finished? Scooch over so I can change.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Aw man...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Helm, let's go in together.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It's okay, I'll change by myself...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Some of these swimsuits could be a challenge to squeeze into.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Quit protesting and get in here.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Wai—!
*Bang*

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Go ahead and take this off.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Jeez, you're wearing more layers than an old granny.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: I can do it myself, just wait...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You've gotta make sure that it's tied nice and tight, otherwise, it'll unravel.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Like this.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Are you sure it's not too tight?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: That's only because you're packing a little extra up top. You should be proud of that.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: I gotta say, this swimsuit is pretty high quality, considering it's a donation.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Do you remember who gave you this? I bet they were weird-lookin'.

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: Must you always say such crass things?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Wait, why are you putting that on over it?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: This isn't up for debate. I'm keeping it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Then what's the point of even wearing a bikini?

lines.speaker: helm
lines.text: It's my choice!

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Just listening is enough to get you hot and bothered.

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: That's what you're thinking, isn't it, Master?

lines.speaker: neon_s
lines.text: Your expression tells me as much.
That's not what I was thinking...
*Bang*

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Tah-dah!

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Incredible, right?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: You came well prepared.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Helm's feeling a bit bashful, so she's wearing a slip over her bikini.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Don't be too upset, Commander.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: I've got a great idea.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Never you mind.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If everyone's finished changing, let's head back to that spot.

lines.speaker: helm_s
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Hey, Rapi.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Don't think you can slink off like that without changing.

lines.speaker: anis_s
lines.text: Get in there.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: *Sigh*
